title: Sweden Moved a 672-Ton Church 5 Kilometers to Save It From a Mine

scenes.text: Sweden picked up an entire church and drove it across town.
It weighs about six hundred and seventy-two tons.
The town of Kiruna sits on a huge iron ore mine.
The ground there is slowly being undermined, so the town has to move.
In August 2025, the church rolled five kilometers on special trailers.

description:
Sweden picked up an entire church and drove it across town.
The 672-ton church in Kiruna was moved about five kilometers in two days in August 2025 to get out of the way of an iron ore mine.
What would you move if you could?
first_comment: Bonus: the whole city center is being relocated, building by building. Would you move with it?
